text: Send the documents anyway. Then take your spouse and go to your Misrad hPnim branch early in the morning. You should be among the first visitors when they open the door. Say that you have to extend your visa, submit a visa renewal request form (you can download it form their website, pint it out and fill it out beforehand). Then you pay 200 smth shek for A5 visa and the same amount for the travel visa (if needed). This visa will be valid until your main appointment. So your penalty is 200 or 400 shek respectively.
